Widget family: TOOLTIP / POPUP

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold):

1. A small floating overlay panel is visible above the canvas clear color with distinct chrome (face + border).
2. Readable label text sits inside the panel bounds.
3. The panel does not fill the entire frame (it is a compact popup, not a full-screen surface).
4. FAIL if: no floating panel, no text, fully transparent/missing surface, or panel is indistinguishable from the clear color.
